basic_info.description: Lovely, modern, light-filled home with ample parking in amazing Excelsior location. This single-family house features an open layout with living room, dining room, and kitchen in succession, great for entertaining or family life. Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and solid cabinetry add appeal to daily meal-making. Three bedrooms on one floor and a fancy bathroom with contemporary shower + bathtub combo complete this welcoming space. The kitchen leads to a deck and sunny garden. The garage level includes a laundry room, additional 1/2-bath, ample storage space, and 2-car tandem parking. Quiet block in close proximity to McLaren Park, Balboa Park BART, Mission Street eating and drinking establishments, and MUNI.
